_design_note:
The kill-shaping question, re-asked on the recipe that actually won. A07's first test ran at a CONSTANT step size (2500 rounds, L00) and was a clean null: take-up 16.5 -> 15.1 percent against its own control, with the activation precondition satisfied at 55 percent. But the step size turned out to carry +1.0976 on the tournament suite (t = +20.2), so that null was measured on a recipe we now know is substantially worse. Potential shaping cannot change the optimal policy, only the speed of reaching it -- and a recipe that converges further may land somewhere the shaping does reach. That is worth one paired test, not an assumption.
A07 needs n_step below the bomb's five-transition life or its term cancels exactly (section 7.28.1), while R02_9 runs n=5. So the pair is run at n=3 together: the control is NOT R02_9.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: reward_version A06 -> A07 relative to the n=3 control above. Event table and death penalty are identical, n_step, budget and schedule match, so the shaping term is the only variable.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_lr_a06n3_5000_20260828/ -- the same recipe with A06
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: None stated. The first A07 test was null and potential shaping is policy-invariant, so if declining the bomb is already right this will be null too. The measured conversion rate of 6.3 percent -- about 0.32 points per kill-opportunity drop -- says it may well be.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share, kills per round, the death split, take-up, and the ten repeats individually.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Ten repeats of classic_versus_opponents for BOTH arms; a single measurement settles nothing (section 7.26.3).
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_cost_to_watch: Report the death split and survival. Pushing toward opponents is expected to raise deaths to opponents; a score gain bought with a survival collapse gets stated as such (section 7.25.3).
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_metric_that_decides_it: Take-up of blast-covering positions from diagnose_kill_opportunities.py, measured on both arms of this pair, plus kills per round. Section 7.28.4: a mechanism baseline has to come from the arm's own control, never from an older arm.
